Shared labour.text: Saturdays we all turn the compost together.
I water on Tuesdays, but it's on the shared rota.

Charity framing.text: Half the beans go to the shelter down the road.

Land tenure.text: The lease runs out in March and nobody has said a word.
We moved the beds back from the fence after the survey.

Food access.text: The nearest grocery is two buses away.

Volunteer burnout.text: It's the same four of us every week now.

Municipal relations.text: The inspector came about the water butts.
